page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-focused x86_64 instance built on KVM hypervisor architecture. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz, containing 16 physical cores and 32 virtual CPUs with two threads per core. The instance is allocated 64.0 GB of memory, yielding 2.0 GB per vCPU, along with a 33 MB L3 cache. Supported CPU instruction flags include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA. It includes no bundled local storage or GPU hardware, relying on external storage attachments, and provides a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Performance tests reveal single-core CPU metrics in the lower benchmark quartile, including a stress-ng single-core score of 1109.99 and a Geekbench single-core score of 960.0. Multi-core performance reaches average benchmark levels, recorded at 23557.71 in stress-ng multi-core tests and 22982.48 in PassMark CPU evaluations. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth measures 74.54 GB/sec, while write speed reaches 34.35 GB/sec, placing memory throughput in the average category despite a lower overall PassMark memory score.

Configured with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.sn1.7xlarge offers high core density relative to memory, rendering it cost-efficient for parallel computing tasks that do not demand extensive RAM per thread. The absence of local disk drives requires reliance on cloud network block storage for persistence. Given its multi-core scaling, the server fits software compilation, Redis cache instances, static web serving, database operations, and prompt processing for small and medium LLM workloads.
